channel.title: North Wales Pioneer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: Heroic Conwy man volunteering into his 80s shortlisted for national award
item.description: A man from Conwy county who continues to volunteer in his 80s has been nominated for a national volunteering award.

item.title: Traveller and Gypsy site in Conwy to be expanded for 'additional family members'
item.description: A Traveller and Gypsy site in Conwy town is set to be expanded by the council due to the "need for additional family members".

item.title: Arrests made after Audi Q3 stolen during burglary at property in Chester
item.description: The pair are also suspected of carrying out burglaries elsewhere in Cheshire and in North Wales.

item.title: Snooker legend and commentator John Virgo dies aged 79 as tributes paid
item.description: John Virgo, who has died aged 79, was known for his playing career in snooker as well as being a commentator for the sport on the BBC

item.title: Red Arrows famous synchro pair to roar over North Wales skies TODAY
item.description: Their arrival marks the start of several days of training, with RAF Mona expected to host a number of practice sorties in the coming days.

item.title: Concerns for Conwy children in B&Bs despite big fall in homelessness numbers
item.description: A councillor has raised concerns over the number of children living in temporary accommodation in Conwy – although the numbers have recently significantly reduced.

item.title: Red Arrows Synchro Pair to fly three more times over North Wales - This is when!
item.description: Three more flights are scheduled for tomorrow. More information is set to be shared.

item.title: Colwyn Bay purpose-built nursing home sold to family-run care provider
item.description: The purpose-built home on Pwllycrochan Avenue was established by ClwydAlyn in 2011.

item.title: ‘Complete waste of money’ Coed Pella chamber hit by more tech failures
item.description: Conwy County Council’s new Coed Pella chamber is facing ongoing technical problems, with councillors raising concerns over faulty equipment, poor sound quality and repeated delays to online meetings.

item.title: Our Town at Venue Cymru: Michael Sheen leads a moving, magical night at the theatre
item.description: Michael Sheen leads a bold and deeply moving Welsh reimagining of Thornton Wilder’s Our Town at Venue Cymru, delivering a captivating, emotionally charged performance that left audiences on their feet.
